name: Hirameki Lab
description: Hirameki Lab — a theme for an after-school STEM academy (robotics, coding, science and making for ages 7 to 15), laid out as a card mosaic under a formal white top header: the lab name and tagline centred on top, a Book a trial lab button at the right and the menu as a centred row underneath (a kouji-orange numbered overlay on phones). Kouji orange (#F6AD49) is the main colour: the project tiles, the featured-project band, every page head and the overlay menu are kouji fields in graphite type. The front page leads with results: a one-line headline with a text link, then a horizontal scroll strip of five student-project cards that bleeds off the right edge, a twelve-card project wall with filter chips, one featured project read in three columns, a courses-by-age table, three lab figures and a trial band. Every project object is a transparent high-key photographic cut-out (WebP) that breaks over the top edge of its tile; a large cut-out robot arm breaks above the featured band and a bottle rocket rises out of the trial band. Photographs are realistic high-key studio images (85mm f/2.8, softbox light, near-white grounds). Space Grotesk for Latin text, Kosugi for Japanese, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Illustration style paper-cut converted to a high-key photo direction (85mm f/2.8, large softbox fill, near-white ground, pale shadows, kouji #F6AD49 accents) per the 2026-10-18 photo rule for commercial themes; the paper-cut feel stays in the layout as flat kouji tiles with cut-out objects lifted over their edges by a soft drop shadow.
